seo.title: Our Impact — Isôoko Community Development
seo.description: See the measurable impact of Isôoko's programs in Masoro, Rwanda — 11,971+ beneficiaries reached.

t1.quote: I started saving just 200 RWF through the program. Today, I own my own shop in Musizi Center. Isôoko gave me the confidence to believe in myself.

t2.quote: The English Club has changed my life. I can now speak confidently and help my younger siblings with their homework.

t3.quote: While I was learning tailoring, the Tûuza Mubyeyi project took care of my child. I can now earn an income and provide for my family.
